items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: Donovan Brown kept her alive. I thank him a whole lot.

ctx.x: Well, anything you want to cut out, we can cut out.

Yeah. Well, she's... I'm the only man she ever knew. I met her when she was 14. Her mother wouldn't let me take her out. And when I did take her out, I had to take her sister. And everybody wanted to know whether I was calling her or her sister, because they were equally beautiful. And I'll say she was beautiful. She's half English and half German. She was a natural blonde. She had a little bit dark. She never did blue or anything. My wife looked at she was fine at 50, and some women looked at 30. Despite of the…
And you had children too, you mentioned. I have a... A daughter?
